notes: Every pinned Kali package name has a preliminary review row, but neither 814 tools nor all subcommands have been individually exercised.
Most tools run as software on an existing laptop; external devices depend on the actual physical workflow.
Hardware inferred from metapackage membership is not necessarily required by that package.
Manufacturer documentation establishes hardware capabilities, not compatibility with every Kali package or kernel release.
Retired products and removed Kali utilities require a replacement/maintenance review before purchase.
Build in phases. Do not acquire every catalog item or add Kali repositories to Ubuntu.
The Dell and Prometheus SSD remain unchanged; any cross-host port must be tested after reconciliation.

hardware_source_catalog.name: Ubuntu Surface Laptop Go / Dell workstation
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: Runs host-side tools, forensics, offline analysis, Prometheus; existing RAM and CPU limit virtualization and GPU tasks.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: Existing computer; no purchase needed.

hardware_source_catalog.name: Isolated local VMs or lab target devices
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: Repeatable authorized tests without affecting production, network or SSD.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: Separate VM or controlled test host; build with existing Dell first.

hardware_source_catalog.name: Powered USB 3.x hub and data cables
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: Keeps multiple USB adapters powered, with separate buses as bandwidth requires.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: Anker/StarTech/other powered hub; validate per-port current and USB data bandwidth.

hardware_source_catalog.name: Raspberry Pi 5 SBC with official supply and cooling
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: Portable Linux sensor/controller, lab host, test target, packet-collection gateway.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: Raspberry Pi 5 8 GB or suitable alternative; Pi not a substitute for specialized RF hardware.

hardware_source_catalog.name: Arduino UNO R4 WiFi or compatible microcontroller board
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: Controlled microcontroller/sensor/CAN protocol test target.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: Arduino UNO R4 WiFi (RA4M1 + ESP32-S3); CAN transceiver required to connect bus.

hardware_source_catalog.name: Dedicated lab router, switch, Ethernet NICs
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: Non-production LAN lab and explicit network-security experiments.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: Spare router and wired NICs; use isolated VLAN or physically separate switch.

hardware_source_catalog.name: Authorized Ethernet network TAP / SPAN-capable switch
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: Observes traffic on an owned network link without installing capture software on endpoints.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: Garland Technology copper/fiber TAP suited to link speed and medium.

hardware_source_catalog.name: Dedicated Wi-Fi access point under user control
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: Safe test target for 802.11 and wireless security tools.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: Spare Wi-Fi router on isolated network; do not test others' networks.

hardware_source_catalog.name: USB Wi-Fi adapter with verified Linux chipset/monitor-mode support
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: Wireless frame capture/analysis in owned lab; laptop built-in adapter may not support monitor mode.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: ALFA AWUS036ACM MT7612U mainline driver; verify monitor capability under current Ubuntu kernel before purchase.

hardware_source_catalog.name: Local Bluetooth controller / BlueZ USB adapter
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: Own-device Bluetooth controller status and basic communication.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: Surface internal Bluetooth radio already detected; add dongle only if separate controller needed.

hardware_source_catalog.name: Bluetooth Low Energy / 802.15.4 development USB board
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: Controlled BLE, Thread, Zigbee and 2.4-GHz firmware/protocol testing.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: Nordic nRF52840 Dongle supports BLE and 802.15.4; it is not a turnkey wideband Bluetooth sniffer.

hardware_source_catalog.name: Ubertooth One specialized Bluetooth adapter
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: Historical Ubertooth package compatibility only.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: Manufacturer marks Ubertooth One retired; source only for compatibility research and verify support before purchase.

hardware_source_catalog.name: RTL-SDR Blog V4 USB receive-only software-defined radio
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: General SDR receive experiments, IQ capture and supported radio decoders.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: RTL-SDR Blog V4; requires V4-compatible Linux drivers; cannot transmit.

hardware_source_catalog.name: HackRF One wideband half-duplex USB SDR
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: Advanced authorized RX/TX RF development and protocol study.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: Great Scott Gadgets HackRF One 1 MHz–6 GHz; use correct filters and dummy load; comply with RF regulations.

hardware_source_catalog.name: YARD Stick One sub-1-GHz transceiver
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: Lab-controlled sub-GHz protocols supported by rfcat/YardStick.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: Great Scott Gadgets YARD Stick One; correct sub-GHz band and antenna/dummy load.

hardware_source_catalog.name: Ettus USRP SDR hardware with UHD driver
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: Professional GNU Radio / UHD SDR workflows, timing and FPGA radio experiments.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: Ettus USRP series; costly and compute-intensive, check particular supported generation.

hardware_source_catalog.name: Proxmark3 RDV4 / current compatible RFID lab reader
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: Authorized 125-kHz and 13.56-MHz RFID tag testing.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: Proxmark3 RDV4 supported branch; firmware and host-client must match; avoid retired clones.

hardware_source_catalog.name: Dedicated UHF RFID reader and test tags
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: 860–960 MHz EPC Gen2 UHF workflows, NOT covered by LF/HF Proxmark3.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: Choose region-compatible, documented reader only for UHF-specific projects.

hardware_source_catalog.name: CCID/PCSC smart-card reader and owned test card
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: Smart-card, PIV and public-key middleware testing.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: Vendor-supported USB CCID reader; check card standards and Ubuntu pcsc-lite.

hardware_source_catalog.name: Digital/analog USB logic analyzer with safe probes
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: Read SPI, I2C, UART, CAN-related logic on bench test fixtures.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: Saleae Logic 8 / Logic Pro 8; recording RAM and USB bandwidth requirements vary.

hardware_source_catalog.name: Bus Pirate 5/6 serial-protocol probe
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: Controlled UART, I2C, SPI, 1-Wire interaction with lab PCBs.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: Dangerous Prototypes Bus Pirate; verify target voltage and signal level.

hardware_source_catalog.name: CMSIS-DAP SWD probe / JTAG debug adapter
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: Firmware inspection/debug with OpenOCD on owned supported target MCUs.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: Raspberry Pi Debug Probe for SWD+UART; JTAG needs compatible alternate probe.

hardware_source_catalog.name: USB-to-UART level-safe serial adapter
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: Read serial console/logs of lab hardware.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: Choose FTDI/CP2102 USB interface; match target voltage 1.8/3.3/5V and isolate high-voltage circuits.

hardware_source_catalog.name: Compatible SPI/EEPROM flash programmer
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: Read/restore lab test board firmware as approved.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: Select programmer by exact flash chip/voltage; back up before any write; Bus Pirate may suffice.

hardware_source_catalog.name: Hardware forensic write blocker and evidence drive
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: Preserve original evidence during physical storage-media forensics.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: OpenText forensic bridge or equivalent USB/SATA/NVMe solution matching source media.

hardware_source_catalog.name: Dedicated evidence/image SSD and backup space
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: Store large read-only disk images, captures and PCAPs without altering Prometheus SSD.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: Separate SSD with capacity >= source media, encrypted if necessary.

hardware_source_catalog.name: GPU workstation with suitable vendor drivers
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: Accelerate authorized offline password audits, ML and large-scale processing.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: Prefer Dell or separate workstation, not Surface integrated Intel GPU; verify ROCm/CUDA/OpenCL support.

hardware_source_catalog.name: Owned Android handset with cable
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: Safe mobile app, adb and controlled mobile-device testing.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: Spare test phone; supported Android version and USB data cable; do not use primary personal phone.

hardware_source_catalog.name: Mac/iPhone development/test hardware
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: iOS/macOS workflows that require Apple proprietary tooling.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: A Mac plus owned iPhone if Apple workflows are actually needed; Linux alone cannot replace Xcode.

hardware_source_catalog.name: Isolated SIP PBX and test endpoint/softphone
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: VoIP/SIP training and call-security analysis.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: Software PBX and softphones can run in VMs; dedicated physical VoIP phones are optional.

hardware_source_catalog.name: USB-CAN adapter (SocketCAN) and isolated CAN test bench
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: Automotive CAN investigation on owned bench hardware.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: CANable with supported gs_usb/candleLight firmware, termination and isolated test harness; use receive-only first.

hardware_source_catalog.name: RF antennas, attenuators, filters, shielding, dummy loads
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: Safe, legal RF measurements and transmit testing in shielded lab.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: Band-matched SMA vs RP-SMA; never transmit out-of-band or use disconnected RF loads.

hardware_source_catalog.name: ESD-safe bench, multimeter, current-limited power and isolation
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: Protect microcontrollers, computers and lab hardware, especially automotive/bench power.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: Insulated probes, bench PSU, ESD mat, voltage measurement and appropriate electrical protection.

hardware_source_catalog.name: USB GNSS/GPS receiver
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: Geo-tag authorized mapping/survey datasets where consent exists.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: Generic USB GNSS receiver with gpsd compatibility; unnecessary for ordinary Wi-Fi analysis.

hardware_source_catalog.name: Cellular modem or shielded private LTE/5G test setup
hardware_source_catalog.purpose: Cellular/SDR lab only with approved frequencies, simulated network and RF isolation.
hardware_source_catalog.choice: Specialized SDR, shielded enclosure/dummy loads, private test SIMs; avoid live carrier access.
